$description: Fixed Calliope palette (Calliope_UX_UI) with three owner decisions (2026-10-29): #1D8286 replaces #25A3A7 for focus and links, #A5289B is the MakeCode colour, #E53F4B (the draft's red) is the error colour. Base tokens only: components never reference these directly, they use the semantic tokens in color.*.tokens.json. No derived scales.

black.$description: Dark-theme page background; text on mid-tone fills

coal.$description: Dark secondary surface, borders on dark

cyan-strong.$description: Focus ring and link text on light (4.58:1 on white, 3.87:1 on mint)

magenta.$description: Highlight (Auszeichnung): marks single items, e.g. a 'new' marker. Not status, not identity, not a call to action

red.$description: Status: error. Errors only. Too light for text on white (4.08:1): error text stays graphite next to a red icon
